text:
Poor working system.
I submitted a request for a single dental crown, but the work was delayed without prior notification. This might be because the company prioritizes larger projects.
Before submitting the request, I inquired with the team and was told the work would be ready in approximately 5 days from the clinic's location. The pickup date was scheduled for 8 days from the submission date (the technician requested a postponement to the 8th, which the clinic agreed to). However, on the 8th, no work was delivered as scheduled, and the clinic was not notified.
The clinic tried to follow up by phone but was unsuccessful. We then contacted the technician via LINE and were informed that the work would be ready for delivery in another 3 days (total time to receive the work was 10 days).
Suggestion to those responsible: Improve the system. Tracking work is difficult, work is not completed on time, and there are multiple delays.
Or perhaps the company prioritizes larger projects first.
